name: Trendlines
description: A collection of all the Trendline objects for the specified series.
remarks: Each Trendline object represents a trendline in a chart. A trendline shows the trend, or direction, of data in a series.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, this property returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Excel application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which this object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Returns a Long value that represents the number of objects in the collection.

methods.name: Add
methods.signature: Add([Type As XlTrendlineType], [Order As Variant], [Period As Variant], [Forward As Variant], [Backward As Variant], [Intercept As Variant], [DisplayEquation As Variant], [DisplayRSquared As Variant], [Name As Variant]) As Trendline

parameters.name: Order
parameters.description: Variant if _Type_ is xlPolynomial. The trendline order. Must be an integer from 2 to 6, inclusive.

parameters.name: Period
parameters.description: Variant if _Type_ is xlMovingAvg. The trendline period. Must be an integer greater than 1 and less than the number of data points in the series you are adding a trendline to.

parameters.name: Forward
parameters.description: The number of periods (or units on a scatter chart) that the trendline extends forward.

parameters.name: Backward
parameters.description: The number of periods (or units on a scatter chart) that the trendline extends backward.

parameters.name: Intercept
parameters.description: The trendline intercept. If this argument is omitted, the intercept is automatically set by the regression.

parameters.name: DisplayEquation
parameters.description: True to display the equation of the trendline on the chart (in the same data label as the R-squared value). The default value is False.

parameters.name: DisplayRSquared
parameters.description: True to display the R-squared value of the trendline on the chart (in the same data label as the equation). The default value is False.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the trendline as text. If this argument is omitted, Microsoft Excel generates a name.

methods.name: Item
methods.description: Returns a single object from a collection.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: The index number for the object.
